Haarithahs are meant to embody a deep connection to their Creator and a profound sense of responsibility towards their fellow beings. They are called to bring people closer to Allah and guide them towards the righteous path. Just as Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) was a Haarith for humanity, a caller or inviter to Allah, and at the same time, the best example of a believer who walked the path of Ihsan.
